about.text: Switzerland’s coffee cream: UHT-treated cream with at least 15 % milk fat, sold in the small portion cups that go with coffee.

links.name: Swissmilk: Crème fraîche, Kaffeerahm und Co.

how.text: Cream from the centrifuge is standardised to at least 15 % and UHT-treated, which gives it a longer shelf life in the portion cup. Stabilisers keep it from feathering in hot coffee.

links.name: Swissmilk: Crème fraîche, Kaffeerahm und Co.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: UHT, held for a few seconds.
Added so the cream does not curdle on the acids and tannins of coffee.
